name: @surfy/surfy-sdk
description: Surfy integrator SDK — layout WC, Surfy React Web, isomorphic client (workspace artefact until npm publish).

surfy.note: Until npm publish: pnpm build:sdk then depend on file:../surfy/dist/surfy-sdk (or worktree path). Platform/Campus React entries export from ./react (SurfyPlatformView3dReact, SurfyCampusView3dReact, usePositionFromGeo). Optional peer maplibre-gl is required at runtime for the MapLibre shell (stories/CI may inject createMap mock).
